1| package store

3| // pass runs one downsample sweep over the shard set, oldest shard
4| // first. A shard holding an active export lease is skipped rather
5| // than raced: the exporter is reading raw resolution, and
6| // downsampling under it would hand the warehouse a mid-copy
7| // resolution change. Skips are recorded in the ledger the storage
8| // rotation reviews.
9| func (s *Store) pass() error {
10| 	for _, shard := range s.shardsOldestFirst() {
11| 		if s.leases.active(shard) {
12| 			s.ledger.recordSkip(shard)
13| 			continue
14| 		}
15| 		if err := s.downsampleShard(shard); err != nil {
16| 			return err
17| 		}
18| 	}
19| 	return nil
20| }
21| 
22| // downsampleShard folds one shard's samples into the next tier and
23| // releases the raw segments it consumed once the fold is durable.
24| func (s *Store) downsampleShard(shard shardID) error {
25| 	fold, err := s.fold(shard)
26| 	if err != nil {
27| 		return err
28| 	}
29| 	if err := s.commit(fold); err != nil {
30| 		return err
31| 	}
32| 	return s.releaseRaw(shard)
33| }
